mapper.sql: a.status in ('submitted','graded') and a.submitted_time is not null and aa.grading_status<>'invalid'

select t.id task_id,t.user_id,t.goal_id,t.exam_subject_id,t.display_snapshot, s.id session_id,s.settled_time completed_at, max(case when ti.item_order=1 then ti.knowledge_point_id end) knowledge_point_id from cm_learning_task t join cm_task_item ti on ti.task_id=t.id join cm_task_attempt ta on ta.task_item_id=ti.id and ta.attempt_no=1 and ta.status='completed' join cm_learning_session s on s.source_task_id=t.id and s.user_id=t.user_id and s.goal_id=t.goal_id and s.session_type='daily_task' and s.status='completed' and s.settled_time is not null where t.user_id=#{userId} and t.goal_id=#{goalId} and (select count(*) from cm_task_item all_items where all_items.task_id=t.id)=2 group by t.id,s.id,s.settled_time having count(distinct ti.id) filter(where ti.item_order in (1,2))=2 and count(distinct ti.item_order) filter(where ti.item_order in (1,2))=2

select ct.task_id,ct.display_snapshot::text,ct.completed_at,es.id subject_id,es.subject_name, ct.knowledge_point_id, count(sq.id)::int question_count, count(*) filter(where a.status in ('submitted','graded') and a.submitted_time is not null and aa.grading_status<>'invalid' and a.is_skipped)::int skipped_count, count(*) filter(where a.status in ('submitted','graded') and a.submitted_time is not null and aa.grading_status='graded' and not a.is_skipped and aa.score_rate=1)::int correct_count, count(*) filter(where a.status in ('submitted','graded') and a.submitted_time is not null and aa.grading_status='graded' and not a.is_skipped and aa.score_rate<1)::int incorrect_count, count(*) filter(where a.id is null or a.status not in ('submitted','graded') or a.submitted_time is null or aa.id is null or aa.grading_status in ('pending','invalid'))::int pending_count from () ct join cm_exam_subject es on es.id=ct.exam_subject_id join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=ct.session_id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.user_id=ct.user_id left join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id group by ct.task_id,ct.display_snapshot,ct.completed_at,es.id,es.subject_name,ct.knowledge_point_id

select exists(select 1 from cm_user_goal where id=#{goalId} and user_id=#{userId})

with facts as ( select s.goal_id,max(a.submitted_time) fact_time from cm_learning_session s join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.user_id=s.user_id join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id where s.user_id=#{userId} and group by s.goal_id union all select s.goal_id,max(s.settled_time) from cm_learning_session s join cm_learning_task t on t.id=s.source_task_id where s.user_id=#{userId} and s.session_type='daily_task' and s.status='completed' and s.settled_time is not null group by s.goal_id union all select r.goal_id,max(r.generated_time) from cm_assessment_report r where r.user_id=#{userId} and r.generated_time is not null group by r.goal_id ), visible as (select goal_id,max(fact_time) last_record_at from facts group by goal_id) select g.id goal_id,ec.certification_name,sv.version_name syllabus_version_name,g.target_exam_date,g.status, (g.status='active') current,v.last_record_at from visible v join cm_user_goal g on g.id=v.goal_id and g.user_id=#{userId} join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=g.certification_id join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=g.syllabus_version_id order by (g.status='active') desc,v.last_record_at desc,g.id desc
select * from () x where x.task_id=#{taskId}

select sq.question_id,a.id attempt_id,s.id session_id,s.session_type,sq.question_order,a.submitted_time answered_at, sq.difficulty_snapshot,sq.presentation_snapshot::text,sq.grading_snapshot::text, sq.knowledge_snapshot::text,aa.answer_data::text, aa.score,aa.max_score,aa.score_rate,aa.grading_status,a.is_skipped skipped, (select count(*) from cm_error_record e join cm_question_attempt ea on ea.id=e.attempt_id join cm_session_question esq on esq.id=ea.session_question_id where e.user_id=#{userId} and e.goal_id=#{goalId} and esq.question_id=sq.question_id and e.status in ('unresolved','correcting')) pending_error_count, (select count(*) from cm_correction_record cr join cm_error_record e on e.id=cr.error_record_id join cm_question_attempt ea on ea.id=e.attempt_id join cm_session_question esq on esq.id=ea.session_question_id where e.user_id=#{userId} and e.goal_id=#{goalId} and esq.question_id=sq.question_id and cr.status='success') successful_correction_count, (select count(*) from cm_error_record e join cm_question_attempt ea on ea.id=e.attempt_id join cm_session_question esq on esq.id=ea.session_question_id where e.user_id=#{userId} and e.goal_id=#{goalId} and esq.question_id=sq.question_id) error_count from cm_learning_session s join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.user_id=s.user_id join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id where s.user_id=#{userId} and s.goal_id=#{goalId} and s.source_task_id=#{taskId} and s.session_type='daily_task' and s.status='completed' and order by sq.question_order
mapper.sql: with valid as ( select s.user_id,s.goal_id,s.id session_id,s.session_type,sq.question_id,sq.question_order, sq.difficulty_snapshot,sq.presentation_snapshot,sq.knowledge_snapshot, a.id attempt_id,a.submitted_time answered_at,a.is_skipped skipped, aa.answer_data,aa.score,aa.max_score,aa.score_rate,aa.grading_status from cm_learning_session s join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.user_id=s.user_id join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id where s.user_id=#{userId} and s.goal_id=#{goalId} and ), latest as ( select distinct on (question_id) *,count(*) over(partition by question_id) attempt_count from valid order by question_id,answered_at desc,attempt_id desc ), errors as ( select esq.question_id,count(*)::int error_count, count(*) filter(where e.status in ('unresolved','correcting'))::int pending_error_count, count(*) filter(where cr.status='success')::int successful_correction_count from cm_error_record e join cm_question_attempt ea on ea.id=e.attempt_id join cm_session_question esq on esq.id=ea.session_question_id left join cm_correction_record cr on cr.error_record_id=e.id and cr.status='success' where e.user_id=#{userId} and e.goal_id=#{goalId} group by esq.question_id ) select l.*,coalesce(e.error_count,0) error_count,coalesce(e.pending_error_count,0) pending_error_count, coalesce(e.successful_correction_count,0) successful_correction_count from latest l left join errors e on e.question_id=l.question_id

sql.if: and (#{correctionStatus}='PENDING_CORRECTION' and x.pending_error_count>0 or #{correctionStatus}='CORRECTED' and x.pending_error_count=0 and x.successful_correction_count>0 or #{correctionStatus}='NONE' and x.error_count=0)

select x.question_id,x.attempt_id,x.session_id,x.session_type,x.question_order,x.answered_at, x.difficulty_snapshot,x.presentation_snapshot::text,x.knowledge_snapshot::text,x.answer_data::text, x.score,x.max_score,x.score_rate,x.grading_status,x.skipped,x.attempt_count,x.pending_error_count, x.successful_correction_count,x.error_count from () x
order by x.answered_at desc,x.question_id desc offset #{offset} limit #{limit}

with errors as ( select count(*)::int error_count,count(*) filter(where e.status in ('unresolved','correcting'))::int pending_error_count, count(*) filter(where cr.status='success')::int successful_correction_count from cm_error_record e join cm_question_attempt ea on ea.id=e.attempt_id join cm_session_question esq on esq.id=ea.session_question_id left join cm_correction_record cr on cr.error_record_id=e.id and cr.status='success' where e.user_id=#{userId} and e.goal_id=#{goalId} and esq.question_id=#{questionId} ) select sq.question_id,a.id attempt_id,s.id session_id,s.session_type,sq.question_order,a.submitted_time answered_at, sq.difficulty_snapshot,sq.presentation_snapshot::text,sq.knowledge_snapshot::text,aa.answer_data::text, aa.score,aa.max_score,aa.score_rate,aa.grading_status,a.is_skipped skipped, count(*) over() attempt_count,e.pending_error_count,e.successful_correction_count,e.error_count from cm_learning_session s join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.user_id=s.user_id join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id cross join errors e where s.user_id=#{userId} and s.goal_id=#{goalId} and sq.question_id=#{questionId} and order by a.submitted_time desc,a.id desc

select min(e.id) fact_id,a.id attempt_id,s.session_type,min(e.detected_time) occurred_at,a.is_skipped skipped,false correction from cm_error_record e join cm_question_attempt a on a.id=e.attempt_id join cm_session_question sq on sq.id=a.session_question_id join cm_learning_session s on s.id=sq.session_id where e.user_id=#{userId} and e.goal_id=#{goalId} and sq.question_id=#{questionId} group by a.id,s.session_type,a.is_skipped union all select min(cr.id) fact_id,ca.id attempt_id,cs.session_type, min(coalesce(cr.settled_time,cr.submitted_time)) occurred_at,false,true from cm_correction_record cr join cm_error_record e on e.id=cr.error_record_id join cm_question_attempt ea on ea.id=e.attempt_id join cm_session_question esq on esq.id=ea.session_question_id join cm_question_attempt ca on ca.id=cr.correction_attempt_id join cm_session_question csq on csq.id=ca.session_question_id join cm_learning_session cs on cs.id=csq.session_id where e.user_id=#{userId} and e.goal_id=#{goalId} and esq.question_id=#{questionId} and cr.status='success' group by ca.id,cs.session_type order by occurred_at desc,fact_id desc

select s.id session_id,s.session_type, case when s.session_type='self_practice' then '知识点练习' else revision.collection_name end title, es.id subject_id,es.subject_name,s.started_time started_at,s.settled_time completed_at, count(sq.id)::int question_count, count(answer.id) filter(where attempt.status in ('submitted','graded') and attempt.submitted_time is not null)::int answered_count, count(answer.id) filter(where attempt.status in ('submitted','graded') and attempt.submitted_time is not null and answer.grading_status='graded' and answer.score_rate=1)::int correct_count, count(answer.id) filter(where attempt.status in ('submitted','graded') and attempt.submitted_time is not null and answer.grading_status='graded' and answer.score_rate<1)::int incorrect_count, coalesce(jsonb_agg(sq.knowledge_snapshot order by sq.question_order,sq.id) filter(where sq.id is not null),'[]'::jsonb)::text knowledge_snapshots from cm_learning_session s join cm_exam_subject es on es.id=s.exam_subject_id left join cm_collection_revision revision on revision.id=s.collection_revision_id left join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt attempt on attempt.session_question_id=sq.id and attempt.user_id=s.user_id and attempt.attempt_no=1 left join cm_attempt_answer answer on answer.attempt_id=attempt.id and answer.grading_status<>'invalid'
group by s.id,s.session_type,revision.collection_name,es.id,es.subject_name,s.started_time,s.settled_time
mapper.select: select count(*) from cm_learning_session s
select * from () practice order by completed_at desc,session_id desc offset #{offset} limit #{limit}
select * from () practice

select sq.question_id,sq.question_order,sq.difficulty_snapshot,sq.presentation_snapshot::text, sq.grading_snapshot::text,sq.knowledge_snapshot::text,sq.ai_rubric_snapshot::text, attempt.id attempt_id,attempt.is_skipped skipped,attempt.submitted_time, answer.answer_data::text,answer.grading_status,answer.grading_result::text, answer.grading_source,answer.grading_revision_no,answer.score,answer.max_score,answer.score_rate from cm_learning_session s join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt attempt on attempt.session_question_id=sq.id and attempt.user_id=s.user_id and attempt.attempt_no=1 and attempt.status in ('submitted','graded') and attempt.submitted_time is not null left join cm_attempt_answer answer on answer.attempt_id=attempt.id and answer.grading_status<>'invalid' where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} and s.goal_id=#{goalId} and s.session_type in ('self_practice','past_paper_practice') and s.status='completed' and s.settled_time is not null order by sq.question_order,sq.id
mapper.sql: ((s.session_type='initial_diagnosis' and s.status in ('settling','completed') and s.submitted_time is not null) or (s.session_type in ('past_paper_exam','simulation') and s.status='completed' and s.settled_time is not null))

select s.id session_id,s.status session_status, case s.session_type when 'initial_diagnosis' then 'INITIAL_DIAGNOSIS' when 'past_paper_exam' then 'PAST_PAPER' else 'SIMULATION' end exam_type, case when s.session_type='initial_diagnosis' then '首次诊断' else revision.collection_name end title, case when s.session_type<>'initial_diagnosis' and subjects.question_count=subjects.subject_value_count and subjects.subject_count=1 then subjects.subject_id end subject_id, case when s.session_type<>'initial_diagnosis' and subjects.question_count=subjects.subject_value_count and subjects.subject_count=1 then subjects.subject_name end subject_name, case when s.session_type='initial_diagnosis' then s.submitted_time else s.settled_time end completed_at, case when report.id is null and s.session_type='initial_diagnosis' and s.status='settling' then 'PROCESSING' when report.id is null then 'UNAVAILABLE' when report.status='available' then 'AVAILABLE' when report.status='failed' then 'FAILED' else 'PROCESSING' end report_status, case when report.status='available' then report.total_score end score, case when report.status='available' then report.max_score end max_score, case when report.status='available' and report.max_score>0 then report.total_score/report.max_score end score_rate, case when s.timing_mode='standard' and s.started_time is not null and s.submitted_time is not null and s.duration_seconds_snapshot>0 and s.deadline_time=s.started_time+(s.duration_seconds_snapshot * interval '1 second') and s.submitted_time>=s.started_time then extract(epoch from least(s.submitted_time,s.deadline_time)-s.started_time)::bigint when s.timing_mode='pausable' and timers.attempt_count=subjects.question_count and timers.attempt_count=timers.valid_timer_count and timers.elapsed_seconds>0 and timers.elapsed_seconds<=s.duration_seconds_snapshot then timers.elapsed_seconds end duration_seconds, case when ((s.timing_mode='standard' and s.started_time is not null and s.submitted_time is not null and s.duration_seconds_snapshot>0 and s.deadline_time=s.started_time+(s.duration_seconds_snapshot * interval '1 second') and s.submitted_time>=s.started_time) or (s.timing_mode='pausable' and timers.attempt_count=subjects.question_count and timers.attempt_count=timers.valid_timer_count and timers.elapsed_seconds>0 and timers.elapsed_seconds<=s.duration_seconds_snapshot)) then s.duration_seconds_snapshot::bigint end duration_limit_seconds, case when ((s.timing_mode='standard' and s.started_time is not null and s.submitted_time is not null and s.duration_seconds_snapshot>0 and s.deadline_time=s.started_time+(s.duration_seconds_snapshot * interval '1 second') and s.submitted_time>=s.started_time) or (s.timing_mode='pausable' and timers.attempt_count=subjects.question_count and timers.attempt_count=timers.valid_timer_count and timers.elapsed_seconds>0 and timers.elapsed_seconds<=s.duration_seconds_snapshot)) then 'AVAILABLE' else 'UNAVAILABLE' end duration_status from cm_learning_session s left join cm_collection_revision revision on revision.id=s.collection_revision_id left join cm_assessment_report report on report.session_id=s.id and report.user_id=s.user_id and report.goal_id=s.goal_id and report.report_type=s.session_type left join lateral ( select count(*)::int question_count,count(sq.exam_subject_id)::int subject_value_count, count(distinct sq.exam_subject_id)::int subject_count,min(sq.exam_subject_id) subject_id, min(subject.subject_name) subject_name from cm_session_question sq left join cm_exam_subject subject on subject.id=sq.exam_subject_id where sq.session_id=s.id ) subjects on true left join lateral ( select count(*)::int attempt_count, count(*) filter(where attempt.timer_status='valid' and attempt.elapsed_seconds is not null)::int valid_timer_count, coalesce(sum(attempt.elapsed_seconds),0)::bigint elapsed_seconds from cm_session_question sq join cm_question_attempt attempt on attempt.session_question_id=sq.id and attempt.user_id=s.user_id and attempt.attempt_no=1 where sq.session_id=s.id ) timers on true where s.user_id=#{userId} and s.goal_id=#{goalId} and
mapper.select: select (select count(*) from cm_learning_session invalid_session where invalid_session.user_id=#{userId} and invalid_session.goal_id=#{goalId} and ((invalid_session.session_type='initial_diagnosis' and invalid_session.status in ('settling','completed') and invalid_session.submitted_time is null) or (invalid_session.session_type in ('past_paper_exam','simulation') and invalid_session.status='completed' and invalid_session.settled_time is null))) + (select count(*) from () x where x.completed_at is null or x.title is null or btrim(x.title)='' or (x.session_status='completed' and x.report_status='UNAVAILABLE') or (x.report_status='AVAILABLE' and (x.score is null or x.max_score is null or x.max_score<=0 or x.score<0 or x.score>x.max_score or x.score_rate is null or x.score_rate<0 or x.score_rate>1)) or (x.report_status<>'AVAILABLE' and (x.score is not null or x.max_score is not null or x.score_rate is not null)) or ((x.subject_id is null) <> (x.subject_name is null)))
select count(*) from () x
select x.* from () x order by x.completed_at desc,x.session_id desc offset #{offset} limit #{limit}
select x.* from () x where x.session_id=#{sessionId}

select sq.question_id,sq.question_order,sq.difficulty_snapshot,sq.presentation_snapshot::text, sq.grading_snapshot::text,sq.knowledge_snapshot::text,sq.ai_rubric_snapshot::text, attempt.is_skipped skipped,attempt.submitted_time,answer.answer_data::text, answer.grading_status,answer.grading_result::text,answer.grading_source, answer.grading_revision_no,answer.score,answer.max_score,answer.score_rate from cm_learning_session s join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join lateral ( select a.* from cm_question_attempt a where a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.user_id=s.user_id and a.status in ('submitted','graded') and a.submitted_time is not null order by a.submitted_time desc,a.id desc limit 1 ) attempt on true left join cm_attempt_answer answer on answer.attempt_id=attempt.id and answer.grading_status<>'invalid' where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} and s.goal_id=#{goalId} and order by sq.question_order,sq.id
